notes.title: 1.3 Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/5b25539dcbfb5af7799f11e6b2835074795fbe2e.jpg[/img]
Thank you for playing Phantom Rose! 1.3 is an end of the year update adding new end game content that players can acquire and a limited event for December.

[h1]NEW[/h1]

[h2]Turbo Roulette Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/7d2594cdf07160d95b26801b9f757e6c4c01c538.jpg[/img]
Turbo Roulette mode is a high risk mode with a much faster roulette gameplay. Everyone including the player is beefed up with more powerful attack cards, meaning creating quick powerful play is the key to victory.

[h2]New Character Skin[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/749c053ca7537b2fda32f6cc9bb3d512aefa59c4.jpg[/img]
New luxury skin has been added that can be acquired with in-game diamond.

[h2]New Weapon Skin[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/f8534df0bf5d1ba28e1d3294bf9ba9f1cc2c2fed.jpg[/img]
New weapon skin has been added that can be acquired by playing endgame modes such as Arcade & Roulette.

[h2]December Limited Event[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/bb193aad7ddcd9a07958fe6ec1fe95a2b8a53622.jpg[/img]
A limited event for December has started. By clearing the Roulette mode 1 time within December, players can acquire a limited skin for Aria. 

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Phantom balances have been adjusted.
[*]Values for Sharpened, Thorn Spikes, Revolution have been adjusted.
[*]New Achievements have been added
[*]Small UI/Visual fixes
[*]Translation fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for reading, and I hope you try out the new update!

notes.title: 1.2 Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/09581da53ccddbb7ec6b57679590fd8bfa15d7ae.jpg[/img]
Thank you for playing Phantom Rose! Today, I’d like to introduce an exciting content update for version 1.2. This update focuses on improving existing game modes with new features, and new content. Please check it out!

[h3]New Events and Items[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/2fd93c91fe6bf822ee2653302097273e5bd8cc6e.png[/img]
New events have been added to Adventure and Roulette mode. These events are designed to allow players to select the type of event that they may want to encounter at the given moment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/8eda5d8c255d82305daf5c5ef1a680041aa6e33e.png[/img]
Further on, a new game event to select “Gifts” has also been added. Gifts are special modifiers that can benefit or put players at a disadvantage depending on the circumstances. They are completely skippable but exist as another opportunity that players can use to drastically change their gameplay experience. Gifts become available once Diamond 2 is cleared.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/8990a2623a2425968b05cb6299420e23178094ca.jpg[/img]
In addition, several new items have been added to aid your adventure and other game modes.

[h3]New Crown Phantoms[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/2d18adda4ef685ed32541f9b0241a4934755ad2b.jpg[/img]
4 brand new Crown Phantoms have been added. These Phantoms will appear after Diamond 2 in Adventure mode, or in Arcade and Roulette mode.

[h3]New Skins[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/3b072ea61cea5d43cea3a5184dd21912d818a6e4.png[/img]
New skins, Maid Aria and Roulette Aria have been added. Maid Aria skin is available in the shop and the Roulette Aria skin is available in the Prize Exchange menu.

[h3]New Diamond Levels[/h3]
3 new Diamond levels have been added with new Trials. Several new Trials have also been added to several previous levels.

[h3]Arcade Turbo Mode[/h3]
Arcade mode has been updated to feature 2 new changes. First, an additional gameplay mechanism has been added to encourage player decision-making. Second, Turbo mode has been added. Turbo mode is an option that can be toggled, and it is designed for faster but riskier gameplay. Rewards remain the same but scores are tracked separately from the normal mode. 

[h3]Custom Game Changes[/h3]
A new feature to create a custom start deck has been added to the Custom Game mode. Players that enjoy creating their own adventure can now also customize the starting deck with any cards that the player has collected. 

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Start Battle Automatically" setting has been added
[*] Sapphire reward screen after defeating a Phantom has been removed and changed to a notification
[*] Additional Ruby Engravings and Blessings have been added.
[*] Phantom balances have been adjusted.
[*] Values for Backstep Shot, Frost Strike, Trauma, Overheat, Over Shield, Silent Shield, Cover Shield, Whisper, Sharpened, Thorn Barrier, Hardened, Acceleration cards have been adjusted.
[*] New Achievements have been added
[*] Small UI/Visual fixes
[*] Translation fixes
[/list]

Thank you for reading, and I hope you try out the new update!

notes.title: 1.1 Content Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/63ac09fbd41591f55d34ae5922952bd8911a4c81.png[/img]
Hello, this is makaroll. Today, I’d like to present the first content update of the game including new features, balance changes, and improvements. I hope you enjoy it and as always, thank you for the support and playing Phantom Rose.

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h3]Roulette Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/8c69ec55088f75d0db5a5b0e67529da283e82f21.jpg[/img]
Roulette is a new game mode that can be unlocked after playing the Arcade. It is a highly randomized game mode with rewards you can use to buy weapon skins and other features in-game. New achievements have been added for Roulette Mode as well.

[h3]Diamond 15[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/55f4c482fd3d9a81d2d9e69b18409eb903d0144c.png[/img]
Diamond adventure has been expanded to 15 and previous Diamond levels have gone through significant changes to compress, improve, and add new trials so that each climb feels more significant and challenging. If you’ve already cleared up to Diamond 14, please make sure to check the changes when playing Diamond 15.

[h3]New Skins[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/470a7d46b6e1f1389c41f169049abcb5c1219faf.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] A new luxury skin, “Cute Aria” has been added to the Shop menu.
[*] A new special skin, “Arcade Aria” has been added to the Prize Exchange menu.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/44645c66d6c97dd2256603a1ca1df230695caa49.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] A new weapon skin series, “Rouge” has been added to the Prize Exchange menu.
[/list]

[h3]New Cards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43653707/4947aa310831144d7164819808babaf0b2e909a6.jpg[/img]
New Booster Card pack has been added for the Mage class.

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
[h3]Blade Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Star Blade’s skill will activate only in odd-numbered phases
[*] Removed En Garde from the card pool
[*] Added Panic Shield to the card pool
[*] Values of Blaze, Snow Shield, Curse Blade, Overheat, Rage, Crystal Pierce, and Ice burn adjusted
[/list]

[h3]Mage Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an additional skill to Heart Blast
[*] Added an additional skill to Energy Burst
[*] Cross Sight’s skill will activate only before an Attack card
[*] Removed Panic Shield from the card pool
[*] Added En Garde to the card pool
[*] Values of Hot Charge, Cover Bolt, Shadow Trick adjusted
[/list]

[h3]Global Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an additional skill to Inferno
[*] Tiedown card’s level change to 3
[*] Cleanse card’s level change to 5
[*] Values for Sharp Strike, Whisper, Rush adjusted
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Other minor balance changes and pattern changes for a few Phantoms
[*] Minor changes to a few Engravings so that they only activate in Adventure mode
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hawk Ray card’s bug when it’s the final card activated in a battle
[*] Azure Dice item bug affecting negative luck changes
[*] Metal Plate item bug in Arcade Mode
[*] Mystery cards not appearing in gallery
[*] Small UI/visual bugs
[*] Loading speed improvements
[/list]

Thank you for reading, and I hope you try out the new update!
